Dress top with a short stack of books, one plain mug and a small closed storage box. Preserve its exact overall L footprint and camera: perfectly horizontal outer TOP wall-contact edge, perfectly VERTICAL outer RIGHT edge, square upper-right corner, empty concave lower-left. Complete silhouette, generous margin, true transparent background and gaps, no wall, floor, people or exterior shadow. Intended export about 345x285 library pixels.
